scripts.build: npm run contracts:generate && npm run build:workbench
scripts.build:workbench: tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/reefproof/api/web/typescript/workbench.ts --bundle --format=iife --platform=browser --target=es2022 --banner:js='/* ReefProof Workbench bundle */' --outfile=src/reefproof/api/web/static/workbench.js
scripts.contracts:check: uv run python scripts/export-workbench-openapi.py --output .local/workbench-openapi-check.json && openapi-typescript .local/workbench-openapi-check.json --output .local/workbench-contracts-check.ts && cmp .local/workbench-contracts-check.ts src/reefproof/api/web/typescript/workbench-contracts.ts
scripts.test:browser: playwright test tests/browser/first-batch.spec.ts --reporter=line && playwright test tests/browser/commissioning-labels.spec.ts tests/browser/foundation.spec.ts tests/browser/route-parity.spec.ts tests/browser/source-imports.spec.ts --reporter=line
scripts.desktop:package: ./scripts/build-desktop-binary.sh && npm run desktop:build && npm run desktop:icons && node scripts/package-desktop.mjs && node scripts/verify-desktop-package.mjs
